capitalsolutionsgroup-capitalsolutionsgr.title: Senior Systems Administrator  (KEY-SA3-03.080626)
capitalsolutionsgroup-capitalsolutionsgr.description: SECURITY CLEARANCE: TS/SCI with both Polygraphs is required POSITION: Senior Network Engineer REQUISITION: KEY-NE3-03.080626) LOCATION: Ft. Meade, Maryland JOB DESCRIPTION: Provides Network support that requires system level design, architecture or enterprise security and security boundaries, datacenter virtualization, CAN/MAN/LAN infrastructure packet capture software, TCP/IP protocol stack, routing/switching protocols, stateful firewalls, and L3/L4 access controls. • (U) Cisco IOS, CatOS, NxOS, filter and access control, Ciscoworks, TACACS+, ASA, FWSM, HP Openview, Cisco routers, Cisco Switches, F5/Cisco load balancers, Infiniband, Juniper, FiberChannel (FC) SAN, and VPN (IPSEC) • (U) Physical installation and configuration and troubleshooting of network routers, switches, load balancers and security devices. • (U) Strong knowledge of TCP/IP protocol stack and routing and switching protocols. • (U) Strong working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols. • (U) Strong working knowledge of stateful firewalls, and L3 access controls. • (U) Working knowledge of Atlassian Tool Suite. • (U) Able to support on-call requirements. • (U) Able to work in live call environment and utilize remedy and/or other ticketing system to track tasking. • (U) Virtualization products; VMWare and Solaris containers. LCAT QUALIFICATIONS: CERTIFICATION: DoD 8570 IAT Level II Certification EXPERIENCE: • Bachelor’s degree + 8 years minimum experience, OR • No Degree + 10 years minimum experience, OR • 8 (eight) years demonstrable experience in network engineering (LAN), architecture, monitoring, security, and protection. Must have datacenter network design and architecture experience to include installation and configuration of Cisco routers, switches, firewalls, and IPSEC virtual private networks. • 2 (two) years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree. NOTE: Bachelor’s degree in related discipline from an accredited college or university is required.

colibrigroup-colibrigroup:lever:dba987a5.title: Growth and Product Marketing Leader
colibrigroup-colibrigroup:lever:dba987a5.description: At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values: Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve! Colibri Healthcare provides professional education and workforce solutions for nurses, nurse practitioners, allied health professionals, and other healthcare learners. Our programs help people prepare for important career milestones, maintain credentials, and continue growing throughout their careers. As we expand, our direct to consumer business, we are organizing marketing around the audiences we serve. Each customer segment has a leader who understands that audience, sets the strategy, and brings the right teams together to grow the business. About the Role The Segment Marketing Lead will be the marketing leader for our Nurse Practitioner audience. You will help more Nurse Practitioners discover, choose, and continue engaging with Colibri Healthcare's education products. You will own the segment's marketing strategy and performance across the full customer journey. You will set priorities, guide a team, and partner with channel experts across paid media, CRM, content, creative, analytics, product, and operations. You will not be expected to personally execute every channel; your impact will come from knowing the customer, making clear decisions, and helping teams move together. This role may be a strong fit if you are a B2C growth marketer who pairs customer empathy with data, can turn insight into a focused plan, and enjoys leading people through change. You are comfortable moving between big-picture strategy and the details needed to make the work real.
responsibilities: Own and evolve the marketing strategy for the Nurse Practitioner segment, connecting customer needs and business goals across awareness, acquisition, engagement, and retention
Build a deep understanding of the Nurse Practitioner audience by combining customer research, market and competitive trends, campaign performance, and direct feedback
Translate insights into clear positioning, messaging, offers, campaigns, and lifecycle programs that feel relevant to Nurse Practitioners and support measurable growth
Lead integrated, full-funnel plans with channel owners and agency partners across paid search, paid social, CRM and email, SEO, organic social, direct mail, and emerging channels
Use acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, revenue, and return on marketing investment data to prioritize opportunities, guide testing, and improve performance
Lead and develop a team of marketing managers and coordinators while creating alignment across Product, Brand, Analytics, Creative, Operations, channel teams, and business leadership
qualifications: 7+ years of B2C marketing experience, including a strong track record leading integrated, multi-channel growth programs
Experience owning the strategy for a defined customer audience, segment, product line, or business area and being accountable for measurable results
Strong understanding of digital acquisition and lifecycle marketing, with the ability to guide specialists and agencies without needing to be the hands on operator in every platform
Comfort using customer research, funnel data, testing results, and financial or performance metrics to make decisions and prioritize investments
Experience managing and developing people, setting clear priorities, and creating accountability while supporting growth and learning
Strong communication and cross-functional influence, including the ability to translate strategy into practical action in a matrixed environment

A bachelor's degree in marketing, business, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience in healthcare, education, professional certification, or another regulated industry is helpful but not required
Tools & Technologies
You do not need to be the day to day operator in every platform, but familiarity with the following will help you partner effectively with channel and analytics teams:
Paid search and paid social platforms, including Google Ads and Meta Ads
CRM, email marketing, and marketing automation platforms
Web analytics, reporting dashboards, and funnel performance tools
SEO, audience research, experimentation, and testing tools

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0da9378a-c1c9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Contractor - Oracle Business Systems Analyst based in India. This is a senior-level opportunity for an experienced Oracle professional to lead complex enterprise application projects for strategic clients. You will oversee initiatives spanning Oracle Cloud ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, and related technologies, translating complex business needs into effective technical and operational solutions. The role combines project leadership, client engagement, delivery management, and strategic problem-solving within a global environment. You will manage distributed teams, project portfolios, budgets, schedules, risks, and change while maintaining strong customer relationships. The position requires confidence working with senior client stakeholders and the ability to adapt delivery approaches across Agile and Waterfall environments. You will also contribute to continuous improvement across project management practices and help identify opportunities to expand client solutions. Lead cross-functional enterprise application projects for clients, overseeing delivery from planning through successful completion. Manage projects involving Oracle Cloud ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Fusion Middleware, and related technologies. Develop integrated project plans and schedules, including critical paths, milestones, dependencies, resources, budgets, and delivery objectives. Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, providing transparent project status updates and maintaining strong relationships with senior and executive stakeholders. Lead globally distributed project teams, coordinating internal and external resources to ensure successful execution across geographies. Monitor project budgets, costs, schedules, scope, risks, quality, and performance, implementing corrective actions when required. Manage project requirements, configuration, performance measures, organizational changes, technology environments, and release schedules through formal change control processes. Balance customer expectations with project constraints while ensuring statements of work, cost baselines, and schedules remain aligned. Manage multiple unrelated projects simultaneously, providing clear visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes for both clients and internal leadership. Tailor project management methodologies and delivery approaches to project size, complexity, and business requirements using both Agile and Waterfall techniques. Conduct risk assessments, performance analyses, and other project health reviews to identify issues and recommend appropriate changes. Organize internal business functions and delivery teams to execute projects within agreed scope while maintaining customer satisfaction. Support business development by identifying opportunities to position additional services and solutions with strategic clients. Contribute to project management office standards, processes, tools, and continuous improvement initiatives across the broader portfolio. Take a hands-on approach when needed, supporting project documentation, presentations, planning materials, and other activities required to ensure successful delivery. Requirements: 10+ years of project or program management experience , or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience. At least 4 years of experience managing ERP, SCM, HCM, or EPM projects in cloud or on-premises environments. 15+ years of professional services experience leading projects for external or internal customers is strongly preferred. Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or another relevant technical or business discipline. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5364c3c1-ae97-.title: Threat Hunting Consultant
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5364c3c1-ae97-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Threat Hunting Consultant based in India. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen enterprise security through proactive threat hunting, advanced detection engineering, and incident response. You will investigate sophisticated threats across endpoint, identity, network, and security analytics environments. The position combines hands-on technical investigation with the development of high-fidelity detections and defensive capabilities. You will leverage Microsoft Defender, Splunk, behavioral analytics, and threat intelligence to identify and disrupt attacker activity. Your work will help reduce false positives, improve detection coverage, and strengthen incident response readiness. You will collaborate with security teams while contributing expertise, documentation, training, and mentoring in a security-focused environment. Conduct hypothesis-driven threat hunts across endpoint, identity, network, and security analytics environments to uncover malicious activity and previously undetected threats. Use Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft 365 Defender/XDR, Splunk Enterprise Security, Splunk UBA, and related platforms to investigate suspicious activity and identify attacker behaviors. Develop and refine high-fidelity detection rules, correlation searches, and threat-hunting queries using KQL and SPL while minimizing false positives. Apply the MITRE ATT&CK framework and current attacker TTPs to guide threat-hunting activities, detection coverage, and defensive improvements. Perform incident response, endpoint forensics, malware analysis, and technical investigations to determine the scope, impact, and root cause of security incidents. Translate threat intelligence into actionable detection logic, hunting hypotheses, response procedures, and other defensive measures. Analyze Windows systems, processes, Active Directory, Azure AD, Kerberos, NTLM, network protocols, traffic patterns, and common attack vectors during investigations. Develop and improve incident response playbooks and automation using PowerShell and/or Python to increase investigation and response efficiency. Document findings, investigative procedures, detection logic, and security recommendations while communicating technical insights clearly to stakeholders. Support security capability development through knowledge sharing, training, mentoring, and continuous improvement of threat detection and response practices. Requirements 5+ years of relevant experience in threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response, cybersecurity operations, or a closely related security discipline. Extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Defender/XDR security operations. Expert-level experience with Splunk Enterprise Security, including advanced SPL for threat hunting, correlation, and security investigations. Experience with Splunk UBA or comparable behavioral analytics platforms. Advanced proficiency in Kusto Query Language (KQL) and strong ability to develop sophisticated hunting and detection queries. Proven experience conducting hypothesis-driven threat hunts and identifying sophisticated attacker behaviors and TTPs. Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and practical knowledge of modern attack techniques. Demonstrated ability to develop high-fidelity detection rules with strong detection coverage and low false-positive rates. Hands-on experience with incident response, endpoint forensics, malware analysis, and security investigations. Knowledge of NIST and SANS incident response frameworks and experience developing or maintaining response playbooks. Strong understanding of Windows internals, processes, security architecture, Active Directory, Azure AD, Kerberos, and NTLM. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e54a02e3-f6dc-.title: Music Publishing Administrator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e54a02e3-f6dc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Music Publishing Administrator based in the United States. This role offers an opportunity to join a fast-paced music publishing environment supporting the accurate administration of valuable music catalogs. You will help ensure publishing metadata, registrations, ownership information, and rights-related records remain accurate and up to date. A key part of the position involves working with collection societies, publishers, and clients to resolve claims and split disputes efficiently. You will combine careful data management with research skills to investigate song histories, credits, recordings, and catalog information. The role also provides exposure to publishing contracts, client onboarding, licensing initiatives, and broader music-rights operations. Success requires strong attention to detail, excellent organization, and the ability to manage competing priorities without losing accuracy. This is a great opportunity for someone passionate about music who wants to develop deeper expertise in publishing administration and rights management. Metadata management: Organize, maintain, review, and update music publishing metadata within internal databases, ensuring records remain accurate and complete. Client onboarding: Support the onboarding of new clients and administration of publishing contracts, ensuring relevant information and documentation are properly captured. Rights registrations: Complete registrations with collection societies and help ensure works and related assets are accurately represented across relevant systems. Dispute resolution: Investigate and resolve claims, ownership issues, and split disputes involving publishers and collection societies. Client support: Respond to publishing-related questions and inquiries from clients, providing clear, timely, and professional assistance. Catalog research: Research catalogs, song histories, songwriter and recording credits, and other relevant information to support publishing administration and rights-management activities. Publishing support: Provide administrative and operational assistance across publishing initiatives, including licensing-related projects. Data organization: Manage large volumes of rights and catalog data efficiently while maintaining a high level of accuracy and consistency. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with publishing colleagues, clients, publishers, and collection societies to ensure issues are addressed and workflows remain efficient. Additional support: Contribute to broader departmental priorities and take on other responsibilities as needed. Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Music, or a related field. Industry experience: 1–3+ years of experience in music publishing administration or a closely related field. Music industry background: Experience working for a music publishing company or record label is an advantage. Rights-management knowledge: Familiarity with collection societies and publishing organizations such as ASCAP, BMI, Harry Fox, and the MLC, including experience handling claims or disputes. Data management: Experience working with databases or data-management systems and the ability to organize large volumes of information accurately. Research skills: Strong ability to conduct basic research, investigate catalog information, and identify relevant insights from multiple sources. Client service: Strong interpersonal and client-service skills, with a professional and solutions-oriented approach to inquiries and complex issues. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain publishing-related matters clearly. Organization: Strong time-management and prioritization skills, particularly when handling multiple deadlines and competing requests. Technical proficiency: Comfortable using macOS, Micros

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:b70c8cbd-79d.description: Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all. About the Role As a Senior Engineer for our Data Platform team, you will be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving our data platform. We are dedicated to designing, implementing and maintaining Hinge’s data infrastructure, while playing a critical role in selecting and implementing technology that will help Hinge to make data-driven decisions, build a best-in-class product, reporting & analytics, and enable ML/AI use cases. You will work cross-functionally with multiple engineering teams, providing leadership and advice while serving as a crucial partner to various teams and stakeholders, including Business Intelligence, Product Data Engineering, Data Science, MLE & AI, and more. You will be making a real impact on the data platform team and will be key to the success of Hinge. Your work will enable the organization to make data-driven decisions and drive improvements, which will affect the love lives of tons of people.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain core services within Hinge’s data platform.
Build and maintain our lakehouse that provides clean, accurate, and robust data sets to be leveraged for reporting, analytics, and machine learning initiatives.
Responsible for maintaining and enhancing data pipelines and database management frameworks, which include tasks such as automation, monitoring, alerting, governance, and cost optimization.
Work on observability systems that enables holistic system and data quality monitoring
Solicit and incorporate internal user feedback to ensure productivity tooling meets the needs of our developers.
Work with our data teams to ensure data is flowing accurately through data creation to our presentation layers.
Continue to learn more about the Data Engineering discipline, utilize that knowledge in your deliverables, and identify opportunities to enhance our pipelines.
Participate in our on-call rotation to ensure system reliability, promptly addressing issues to ensure smooth operations.

redesignhealth-redesign-health:ashbyhq:a.title: New Ventures Senior Associate
redesignhealth-redesign-health:ashbyhq:a.description: ABOUT THE COMPANY Redesign Health http://redesignhealth.com is a global venture and applied technology firm focused on building next-generation healthcare companies. We manage venture capital and venture buyout strategies, each powered by an AI operating system and team of leading technologists, entrepreneurs, and investors. Our venture capital strategy backs exceptional founders at the earliest stage, often before an idea is fully formed, often providing the first institutional capital and an unmatched degree of strategic healthcare-specific leverage through exit. Our venture buyout strategy partners with proven management teams at existing incumbents via control investments and delivers outsized value by rewiring core products and workflows with AI. Since inception in 2018, Redesign and our portfolio companies have touched the lives of more than 15 million patients, raised over $1.5 billion from premier institutional, sovereign, and strategic investors, and built distinctive partnerships with marquee healthcare organizations around the world. Redesign is based in New York and has offices in Bengaluru, Los Angeles, and Riyadh. ABOUT THE ROLE Redesign Health is hiring an early-stage investor to focus on pre-seed deal sourcing and relationship development, with a particular emphasis on expanding our network in the healthcare AI ecosystem. This is a sourcing-first role for a self-starter who is energized by networking and excited to build relationships with high-potential founders. This role focuses on the earliest stage of our investment pipeline developing proprietary relationships, generating differentiated deal flow, and creating early access to amazing founders in Redesign Health’s strike zone. You will combine strong interpersonal instincts with structured sourcing discipline, and work closely with your partner Redesign Health teams on the path to Investment Committee. We are looking for someone who is AI-innate and naturally uses AI tools, data signals, and workflow automation to build a differentiated sourcing engine. The best candidates are natural connectors with strong founder instincts who can combine judgment, hustle, ecosystem fluency, and AI tooling to turn fragmented signals into real founder relationships at 10x the scale than anyone could have done previously. WHAT YOU’LL DO Founder & Ecosystem Development - Build a dense, trusted network across founders, angels, scouts, venture funds, operators, and entrepreneurial communities. Develop real market presence in the places where exceptional founders actually emerge. Expand Redesign’s network and visibility in the AI healthcare ecosystem by tracking which operators are turning into founders, which micro-communities are producing breakout talent, and where conviction is building before the rest of the market catches up. Bring those insights back into Redesign’s investment process and broader platform. Active Founder Sourcing - Source high-potential pre-seed investment opportunities through relationship-driven founder sourcing. Identify founders who fit Redesign’s from pre-idea founders just starting to explore their next venture to founders leading pre-seed stage companies. Sourcing should cover operator networks, universities, accelerators, founder communities, events/dinners, and other relevant digital channels via a combination of active in-market engagement and desk sourcing. You’ll maintain an active, high-quality pipeline of founders / deals and have a strong point of view on the level of attention needed for each to convert. Maintaining Our Founder Bar - Understand what exceptional founders look like and ensure that our founders in our pipeline reflect that expectation. As you continue to engage founders, you should be relaying learnings for founder attributes and signals we should prioritize as part of any future sourcing activities.
